create_chrf_scorer: create a ChrF scorer instance to evaluate machine translation hypotheses against reference translations
score_corpus_chrf: score a corpus of hypotheses against references using the ChrF scorer with multiprocess support
score_sentences_chrf: score individual sentences using the ChrF scorer to get per-sentence chrF metrics
get_chrf_corpus_statistics: get aggregated n-gram precision and recall statistics across a corpus for chrF computation
get_default_chrf_args: get default chrF configuration arguments including whitespace mode, order, and beta parameters
